meta.source: Graphite theme preset of the Artifact Next.js + shadcn/ui admin kit (artifact-nextjs-template.vercel.app), read from the live page's CSS variables on 2026-10-15. Names follow shadcn/ui so the tokens drop straight into globals.css.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every console view. Content areas sit on it as cards; never place body text on anything darker than card in light.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default ink: body text, table cells, icons. 10.5:1 on background (light), 11.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels, stat tiles, table containers, dialogs. One step lighter than background; always paired with a border.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, command palette, tooltips. Same value as card; add shadow-sm to lift it.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text in popovers.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one emphasis colour: primary buttons, active nav item, checked controls, focus ring. Deliberately grey so data colours and status colours stay the loudest thing on screen.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. 5.9:1 (light), 7.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, segmented controls at rest, table header ground.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Disabled fills, skeleton loaders, code blocks, zebra rows, row hover.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, column headers, helper text, timestamps. 5.3:1 on background (light), 5.0:1 (dark). Never below 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected ground for menu items, list rows, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, revoke, suspend: the destructive button fill, error text, failed status. In dark use it as text or outline on background, not as a filled button with white text (2.9:1).

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill. Light: white on #cc3333, 5.1:1. Dark: ink on #e06666, 6.2:1 (the source kit uses white here, which fails; this system overrides it).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status: active, healthy, completed, up-trend deltas. As text on background it reads 4.6:1 (light) and 7.6:1 (dark); as a badge, tint it with the ground and keep the text in success or foreground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention status: pending, degraded, needs review. A fill or icon colour only: as text on background it fails (about 1.9:1 light), so a warning badge uses this as a dot or tint and foreground for its label.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card edges, table rules, dividers, sidebar edge. Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of text fields, selects and textareas at rest. Light: 1.3:1 against background, so fields also rely on their white-ish fill and label; focus moves to ring.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px, offset 2px, on every interactive element. Keyboard users live here.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Navigation rail ground. A shade off background so the edge reads without a heavy border.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav item text.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active nav indicator, workspace mark.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hover and current-page ground for nav items.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Nav item text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Rail edge and section dividers inside it.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series. The chart scale is greys plus one slate-teal so series differ by lightness, not hue.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series and comparison lines (previous period). The only hue in the palette.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series, area fills.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series, gridlines, reference bands.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title, one per view. Also the big number in a stat tile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and section headings, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: table cells, form values, descriptions, menu items.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Button labels, nav items, emphasised cells (a name, an ID).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Dense tables, helper text, timestamps. In muted-foreground.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, form labels, badge text, sidebar group names. Column headers in muted-foreground, uppercase optional.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: IDs, hashes, amounts in tables, API keys, logs. Tabular figures align columns.

spacing.note: A 4px base (the kit's --spacing: 0.25rem). Console density: 8px inside controls, 12px between related things, 16px card padding, 24px between cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs vertically; gap between inline controls; table cell padding in dense rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (default density), gap between form fields, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding, sidebar item padding, gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid, page gutter on narrow screens, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens, space above a page title.

radius.note: Base radius 0.35rem (5.6px): tight, nearly square, so dense tables and controls stay crisp.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, code spans, table-cell chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, menu items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, dialogs, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large containers and empty-state illustrations. Rare.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only. No pill buttons in this system.

shadow.note: Borders separate surfaces; shadow is reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, the command palette: a flat 2px drop, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets over a scrim.
